title: 第1章 西边捡来的项西(1)

content_zh:
外面的天已经黑了，隔着窗能看到光秃秃的树枝，被北风吹得就跟要向天再借五百年似的摇晃着。
天气预报说明天有雪，看这样子，估计今儿晚上就要下了。
隔壁诊室的刘大夫正半吼着跟一个耳背的病人说话，说了一天话，这会儿再吼一阵，嗓子听着都像是要劈了。
程博衍飞快地拿过一片润喉糖塞进嘴里，叫进了下一个病人。
一个大妈被扶进来坐下了，一条腿不能着地，哎哟哎哟的，脸上的表情挺痛苦。
她坐下之后盯着程博衍看了一会儿，在程博衍开口问她之前抢着说了一句：“隔壁那个年纪大些的大夫有空吗？我能不能让他看？”
“他那边也有病人啊，您要挑医生得在预约的时候挑，”程博衍笑了笑，“您是伤着腿了？”
“约不上啊，我也不能提前几天就知道自己腿要断啊，”大妈指了指自己的腿，“不能换个大夫吗，我年纪大了，也断不了几回了，年纪大点儿的大夫经验足点儿不是吗？”
程博衍有些无奈：“我先给您看看好吗？您别再耽误了病情。”
大妈瞅了瞅程博衍，大概是疼得难受，没再多说什么，只是说：“那小伙子你给我好好接上。”
“大妈，”程博衍从椅子上起来，蹲到了大妈跟前，“是小腿疼？”
“是呢，”大妈拧着眉，“你说神不神，我就看个电视，愣是把腿给看折了！这叫什么事！”
“怎么看的？”程博衍愣了愣，是挺神的，他伸手想轻轻把大妈的裤腿推上去看看，但大妈穿得多，没成功。
“我就把腿搭茶几上，看完中央一那个《今日说法》，我想着睡一会儿再出去买菜吧，家里没菜了，得去买，做好了再伺候那几个吃货……”
“大妈，”程博衍不得不打断她的话，“睡一会儿，然后呢？”
“然后？没然后啦，我一抬腿，”大妈说着往桌上拍了一巴掌，“咔嚓！腿折了！沾不了地了！等着我姑娘回家就送我过来了，哎，疼死我了，大夫你快给我接上。”
程博衍明白了是怎么回事，跟陪在一边的大妈的女儿说了一下，然后开了单子让先拍个片子。
“大夫，你说我这是怎么了？我天天早锻炼还撞树呢，哐哐的！怎么抬个腿就能折了？你见过我这样的吗？这得是独一份了吧？”大妈很不理解自己的情况。
“年纪大了，骨质疏松，您这也不是太少见，”程博衍笑笑，低头飞快地开了单子，“上午还有个大姐起床翻个身把大腿给翻折了呢，不过您平时得注意，那个撞树……还哐哐的，就别撞了，拿这个去拍个片子，给您加急了。”
大妈的片子出来之前程博衍看完了最后几个病人，已经到了下班的点，他看了看时间，今天说好了去奶奶家吃饭，估计这会儿饭都快做好了。

他只能抽时间飞快地给老妈发了条短信说要晚点儿。
好在这个时间拍片的人不多，大妈加急的片子出来了，程博衍看了看片子，骨折的情况不算太严重，做个外固定就可以了。
“大夫，”大妈坐在治疗室里看着程博衍，“耽误你下班了吧？”
“没事，您这儿弄好我就下班了，”程博衍看了看她，“我得给您……”
“我知道我知道，你等我脱了，”大妈立马一招手，她女儿过来帮着她把一条裤腿给脱了下来，“我要知道看个电视能看骨折了，肯定不穿这条细腿裤子。”
大妈话很多，程博衍沉默着给她做固定的时候，她一直在提问：“大夫，多大了？”
“快三十了。”程博衍回答。
“哟，那不小了，看不出来，看着也就二十八九。”大妈说。
“……是吗。”程博衍笑了笑。
“结婚了没？”大妈又盯着他的脸问。
“没。”程博衍给她把夹板固定上。
“女朋友呢？”大妈很热情地说，“你们这么忙，肯定没工夫谈恋爱吧？”
程博衍怕再说下去大妈该热情地把他的婚姻大事给包办了，于是回答：“有女朋友了。”
“噢……”大妈有些失望地转头瞅着女儿，“那隔壁老陈家那姑娘没戏了，这大夫长得多俊啊。”
“人没女朋友也没老陈家姑娘什么戏啊，”她女儿很无奈，“妈您别瞎问了，多不礼貌，人大夫忙着呢，您别老打岔。”
好容易把大妈给送走了，程博衍松了口气，换了衣服锁好门，快步走出了医院大门。

content_en:
It was already dark outside, and bare branches could be seen through the window, swaying in the north wind as if they were asking for another five hundred years from the sky.
The weather forecast says there will be snow tomorrow. From the looks of it, it's probably going to snow tonight.
Dr. Liu in the next door clinic was half-snarling to a deaf patient. He had been talking for a whole day, and now he was shouting for a while, and it sounded like his throat was about to be split.
Cheng Boyan quickly took a piece of lozenge and stuffed it into his mouth and called in the next patient.
An aunt was helped in and sat down. One of her legs couldn't touch the ground. She was oopsing, and the expression on her face was quite painful.
After sitting down, she stared at Cheng Boyan for a while, and before Cheng Boyan asked her, she rushed to say: "Is the older doctor next door free? Can I let him look at it?"
"He also has patients there. If you want to choose a doctor, you have to choose it during the appointment." Cheng Boyan smiled, "Did you hurt your leg?"
"I can't make an appointment. I can't know that my leg is going to be broken a few days in advance." The aunt pointed to her leg. "Can't I change the doctor? I'm old and I can't break it many times. An older doctor has more experience, right?"
Cheng Boyan was a little helpless: "Can I take a look at you first? Don't delay the condition any longer."
The aunt looked at Cheng Boyan, probably because she was in unbearable pain, and didn't say anything more. She just said, "Young man, please pick it up properly."
"Auntie," Cheng Boyan got up from the chair and squatted in front of her, "Does your calf hurt?"
"That's right," the aunt frowned, "You said I'm not awesome, but I just watched TV and my legs were broken! What's this?"
"How do you see it?" Cheng Boyan was stunned for a moment. He was very impressed. He reached out and tried to gently push up the aunt's trouser legs to have a look, but the aunt was wearing too much and was unsuccessful.
"I put my legs up on the coffee table and read the "Today's Statement" in Central 1. I thought about taking a nap before going out to buy groceries. I have no groceries at home, so I have to buy them. Once they are ready, I can serve those foodies..."
"Auntie," Cheng Boyan had to interrupt her, "Sleep for a while, what next?"
"Then? No, I raised my leg," the aunt said and slapped the table. "Crack! The leg is broken! It can't touch the ground! She sent me here when my girl came home. Oh, it hurts me so much. Doctor, please pick it up for me."
Cheng Boyan understood what was going on, talked to the aunt's daughter who was accompanying him, and then made an order to take a film first.
"Doctor, what do you think is wrong with me? I exercise every morning and bump into a tree, bang! How come it breaks just by raising my leg? Have you ever seen me like this? Is this the only one?" The aunt didn't understand her situation.
"You are old and have osteoporosis. This is not uncommon for you." Cheng Boyan smiled, lowered his head and opened the order quickly. "In the morning, a eldest sister got up and turned over and her thigh was bent. But you have to pay attention to the one that hit the tree...it still made a bang. Don't hit it. I will take a picture with this and I will rush it for you."
Cheng Boyan had finished watching the last few patients before Auntie's film came out, and it was already time to get off work. He looked at the time and agreed to go to grandma's house for dinner today. It is estimated that the meal will be ready by now.
He could only find time to quickly send a text message to his mother saying that he would be late.
Fortunately, there were not many people taking pictures at this time, and the aunt's urgent film came out. Cheng Boyan looked at the film and found that the fracture was not too serious, and an external fixation would be enough.
"Doctor," the aunt sat in the treatment room and looked at Cheng Boyan, "will it delay your get off work?"
"It's okay. I'll get off work as soon as you finish it here." Cheng Boyan looked at her, "I have to give you..."
"I know, I know, just wait until I take it off." The aunt immediately waved her hand, and her daughter came over to help her take off a pair of trouser legs. "If I know that I can see fractures while watching TV, I definitely won'tWear these skinny pants. "
The aunt talked a lot, and while Cheng Boyan was silently fixing her, she kept asking: "Doctor, how old are you? "
“Almost thirty. "Cheng Boyan replied.
"Hey, that's not too small. You can't tell, but you only look like 28 or 29. "Aunt said.
"...Really? "Cheng Boyan smiled.
"Are you married? "Auntie asked, staring at his face again.
"No. "Cheng Boyan fixed the splint for her.
"Where's the girlfriend? The aunt said enthusiastically, "You are so busy, you must not have time to fall in love, right?" "
Cheng Boyan was afraid that if he continued talking, his aunt would enthusiastically arrange his marriage, so he replied: "I have a girlfriend. "
"Oh..." The aunt turned to look at her daughter with some disappointment, "Then the girl from the old Chen family next door is out of luck. How handsome this doctor is. "
"What's the point of having a girlfriend and a girl from the Chen family?" Her daughter felt helpless, "Mom, please stop asking blind questions. It's so rude. The doctor is busy, so don't interrupt us all the time. "
After finally sending the aunt away, Cheng Boyan breathed a sigh of relief, changed his clothes, locked the door, and quickly walked out of the hospital gate.
